Style around the occasion

Plan the display

This artificial Christmas tree adds a festive detail to your Christmas display.

Compact Format
The compact format helps the item fit into a smaller working or storage area. It is useful where you want the function close to hand without filling the whole space.

Create a focal point
Use the decoration to draw attention to a chosen part of your arrangement. Giving it a little space around neighbouring pieces helps its outline and detail remain visible, whether it is displayed on its own or as part of a coordinated group.

Style around the occasion
A decorative accessory can help mark an occasion or refresh an established display. Arrange it with pieces of different heights or forms, keeping the overall grouping proportionate to the available space and the setting in which it will be viewed.

Give the detail room to show
Consider the background as well as the decoration itself. A simpler surrounding arrangement can make smaller details easier to appreciate, and a position away from visual clutter helps the chosen design remain the focus of the display.

A flexible finishing touch
Move the decoration within its intended setting when you want to change the look of an arrangement. Small adjustments to spacing and neighbouring colours can give familiar accessories a different presentation without adding more pieces.

Plan the display
Choose a suitable support or display position for the size and form of the product. Allow enough space around it for the room to remain practical, and use the stated indoor or outdoor suitability when deciding where it should be placed.

Care and presentation
Follow the care guidance for the stated material and handle decorative details gently. When the display changes, store the piece where its surface and shape will be supported, ready to bring out again for the next arrangement.

Versatile styling allows it to serve as a focal point or complement larger holiday arrangements.

Table And Wreath Arrangements: Incorporate the white eucalyptus foliage into Christmas table centrepieces, decorative wreath projects or indoor wedding displays. The glittered leaves provide a repeated accent that can link place settings, mantel greenery and other seasonal arrangements.

8941467526356.baseName: Christmas Tree Topper Star Natural Rattan 10 in 50 LED Dual Power Warm White Handmade Rustic Xmas Decor
8941467526356.variantName: Christmas Tree Topper Star Natural Rattan 10 in 50 LED Dual Power Warm White Handmade Rustic Xmas Decor
8941467526356.sourceDescription:
Handmade from natural rattan, this five point star tree topper brings a warm rustic farmhouse feel to the top of the tree. Fifty warm yellow LEDs are wrapped in brown wire and arranged into the star shape, giving a soft glow that lifts the whole room without the cold glare of a metal topper. Unlike painted metal, natural rattan does not fade or rust, so it can be packed away after Christmas and brought out again the following year.

Power comes from a USB cable or from three AA batteries, which are not included. A switch on the battery box chooses between two modes: constant on, or an automatic timer that keeps the lights on for six hours and then off for eighteen, so the tree lights itself each evening at the same time. Open the battery cover to fit the cells, rest the star on the top or the side of the tree, then slide the switch.

The star measures 10 in wide and 11.81 in tall and weighs 6.52 oz. Its spring base is 2.36 in across and grips the top branch firmly, keeping the topper upright even on a slim tree. The natural brown tones sit well with warm white fairy lights, wood, linen and dried fruit ornaments, and suit indoor or outdoor seasonal decorating as well as weddings, parties, shops, restaurants, hotels and living rooms.

You receive one rattan star tree topper with a battery case. Batteries are not included.

5056797098756.sourceDescription:
Add a modern festive glow to any room with this Christmas neon silhouette light from MySmartBuy. Energy-efficient LEDs give a bright neon-style look. Ideal for windows, bedrooms, living rooms, offices and parties, it stays cool to the touch. Neon-style lights give maximum impact from a single piece, so you can create a festive feature without clutter. Being USB powered, it can be run from a USB plug, laptop or power bank, and the inline switch means you can turn it on and off without unplugging. It also makes a fun backdrop for Christmas party photos. It is USB powered, with a 2m cable and inline on/off switch. Festive lights are a simple way to bring warmth and atmosphere to dark winter evenings. Group them with candles, greenery and decorations, place them where they can be seen from outside, or use them to create a cosy corner for the family to enjoy throughout December. A simple, stylish way to bring festive sparkle into your home, and a lovely finishing touch for Christmas displays and parties. At a glance: neon silhouette light | LED | USB powered | 2m cable with on/off switch | cool to touch | indoor use.
NEON SILHOUETTE LIGHT : A modern festive glow for any room.
2M CABLE WITH SWITCH : USB powered with an inline on/off switch.
COOL TO TOUCH : Comfortable, safe illumination.
ENERGY-EFFICIENT LEDS : A bright neon-style glow that is economical to run.
INDOOR CHRISTMAS DECOR : Windows, bedrooms, living rooms, offices and parties.

5096042275556.baseName: Christmas wreath - Christmas door wreath - Red bow and gold baubles for hanging on a door or wall - Red, gold and green, 50 cm
5096042275556.variantName: Christmas wreath - Christmas door wreath - Red bow and gold baubles for hanging on a door or wall - Red, gold and green, 50 cm
5096042275556.sourceDescription:
A red bow gives this handmade wreath a clear focal point. Follow it round the ring and the finish changes from shiny red and gold baubles to rough pine cones and small golden berries nestled amongst the greenery. At 50 cm across, it is easy to measure out the space it will occupy before choosing a position.

A wreath puts the decoration on the door or wall itself, leaving the console or mantelpiece below free for cards and winter flowers. Its outline is complete in one piece, which is handy in an entrance where there is little space for a tree. For a simpler finish, keep additional decorations to one part of the ring and let the natural shape of the foliage show elsewhere. A ribbon tied off-centre can pick up a colour from the tree without covering the sprigs.

When you unpack the greenery, support the wreath from behind and ease any compressed outer sprigs apart gently. Turn the wreath as you work so that you can check the outline from the front as well as from the side. From a few steps away the cones read as dark accents. Closer up, their overlapping scales contrast with the finer foliage. A simple ribbon or a nearby wooden decoration will pick up that woodland detail.

For a wall arrangement, try the wreath above a narrow console with the centre of the design just below eye level. A clear strip of wall between the wreath and the furniture shows off the outline and leaves the surface free for keys or Christmas cards. On a mantel wall, the wreath can sit above the display while the shelf below stays clear for cards and small ornaments. Leave a little space between the top of the cards and the bottom of the wreath so their outlines remain distinct.

To carry the colours into the rest of the room, pick out one detail from the wreath and repeat it in wrapping ribbon, a table runner or decorations on the tree.
Handmade Christmas wreath featuring a striking red bow and gold baubles for festive door or wall decoration.
Measures 50 cm in diameter, making it an ideal size for standard doors and walls without overwhelming the space.
Combines shiny red and gold baubles with natural pine cones and golden berries nestled among greenery for texture.
Complete one-piece design allows for easy hanging on doors or walls, keeping console tables clear for other items.
Comes with 1x Christmas wreath

5058194828356.sourceDescription:
Christmas Wreath
This Christmas wreath adds a festive detail to your Christmas display. The green and red finish and plastic construction give it a defined appearance for Christmas at home.

Battery Powered
Battery power gives flexibility over positioning without relying on a nearby mains socket during use. Fit the specified battery type and follow the supplied instructions.

Create a focal point
Use the decoration to draw attention to a chosen part of your arrangement. Giving it a little space around neighbouring pieces helps its outline and detail remain visible, whether it is displayed on its own or as part of a coordinated group.

Coordinate colour and texture
Pair the stated colour and material with accents already present in the room. Repeating a colour across a few carefully chosen accessories can bring the arrangement together, while contrasting textures add interest without requiring a complete change of decor.

Style around the occasion
A decorative accessory can help mark an occasion or refresh an established display. Arrange it with pieces of different heights or forms, keeping the overall grouping proportionate to the available space and the setting in which it will be viewed.

Give the detail room to show
Consider the background as well as the decoration itself. A simpler surrounding arrangement can make smaller details easier to appreciate, and a position away from visual clutter helps the chosen design remain the focus of the display.

A flexible finishing touch
Move the decoration within its intended setting when you want to change the look of an arrangement. Small adjustments to spacing and neighbouring colours can give familiar accessories a different presentation without adding more pieces.

Product details
Material: Plastic. Colour: Green and Red. Quantity: 1 piece.
Battery powered for flexible positioning without needing a mains socket.
Festive green and red plastic design adds a defined Christmas detail to your display.
Includes one piece of decorative wreath for immediate home styling.
Easy to move and adjust within your arrangement for a flexible finishing touch.

The EVRE Pre-Lit Frosted Christmas Wreath is a 60 cm (24 inch) artificial wreath with green and lightly frosted tips, snow-dusted pine cones and red berries, pre-strung with 50 LED lights for a warm festive glow. It runs on batteries with a built-in daily timer, so there is no plug or cable to hide, making it easy to hang above a fireplace, on a wall or on a sheltered front door, and it can be stored away and used again Christmas after Christmas.
Pre-lit 60 cm (24 inch) frosted artificial Christmas wreath with 50 LED lights, snow-dusted pine cones and red berries.
Battery operated with no plug or cable: runs on 3 x AA batteries (not included). Built-in timer: 6 hours on, 18 hours off, every day.
100 mixed PVC and PE tips with a light frosting. Use indoors or on a sheltered front door. Keep the battery box dry.
Size: 60 cm (24 inch) diameter and about 25 cm deep. Weight about 0.9 kg.
The lights run on 3 x AA batteries (not included), so there is no plug or cable to hide. A built-in timer keeps it lit for 6 hours, then off for 18 hours, every day until you switch it off.

Reusable: store it in a cool, dry place after Christmas and use it again next year. Clean with a damp cloth.
Safety: for decorative use only. Keep away from fires, heaters and naked flames, and keep small parts away from young children and pets.

Christmas Decoration
This Christmas decoration adds a festive detail to your Christmas display. The red finish and polyester construction give it a defined appearance for Christmas at home.

Compact Format
The compact format helps the item fit into a smaller working or storage area. It is useful where you want the function close to hand without filling the whole space.

Create a focal point
Use the decoration to draw attention to a chosen part of your arrangement. Giving it a little space around neighbouring pieces helps its outline and detail remain visible, whether it is displayed on its own or as part of a coordinated group.

Coordinate colour and texture
Pair the stated colour and material with accents already present in the room. Repeating a colour across a few carefully chosen accessories can bring the arrangement together, while contrasting textures add interest without requiring a complete change of decor.

Style around the occasion
A decorative accessory can help mark an occasion or refresh an established display. Arrange it with pieces of different heights or forms, keeping the overall grouping proportionate to the available space and the setting in which it will be viewed.

Give the detail room to show
Consider the background as well as the decoration itself. A simpler surrounding arrangement can make smaller details easier to appreciate, and a position away from visual clutter helps the chosen design remain the focus of the display.

A flexible finishing touch
Move the decoration within its intended setting when you want to change the look of an arrangement. Small adjustments to spacing and neighbouring colours can give familiar accessories a different presentation without adding more pieces.

5037204473656.sourceDescription:
Inflatable Santa
This inflatable santa adds a festive detail to your Christmas display.

Father Christmas Motif
A Father Christmas motif gives the design a recognisable festive character. It brings a seasonal focal point to the arrangement and can be paired with other Christmas decorations to create a consistent theme across the display.

Create a focal point
Use the decoration to draw attention to a chosen part of your arrangement. Giving it a little space around neighbouring pieces helps its outline and detail remain visible, whether it is displayed on its own or as part of a coordinated group.

Style around the occasion
A decorative accessory can help mark an occasion or refresh an established display. Arrange it with pieces of different heights or forms, keeping the overall grouping proportionate to the available space and the setting in which it will be viewed.

Give the detail room to show
Consider the background as well as the decoration itself. A simpler surrounding arrangement can make smaller details easier to appreciate, and a position away from visual clutter helps the chosen design remain the focus of the display.

A flexible finishing touch
Move the decoration within its intended setting when you want to change the look of an arrangement. Small adjustments to spacing and neighbouring colours can give familiar accessories a different presentation without adding more pieces.

Plan the display
Choose a suitable support or display position for the size and form of the product. Allow enough space around it for the room to remain practical, and use the stated indoor or outdoor suitability when deciding where it should be placed.

Care and presentation
Follow the care guidance for the stated material and handle decorative details gently. When the display changes, store the piece where its surface and shape will be supported, ready to bring out again for the next arrangement.

Product details
Material: Fabric. Stated size: 88 x 60 x 184 cm. Quantity: 1 piece.
Recognisable Father Christmas motif adds a festive focal point to your holiday display.
Compact inflatable design allows for easy storage and flexible positioning within any setting.
Durable fabric construction ensures longevity while maintaining its shape for seasonal use.
Versatile decoration suitable for enhancing both indoor and outdoor Christmas arrangements.
Guarantee - 1 month
Suitable for: Indoor & outdoor use
Comes with 1 Piece
